scenarios.name: The Test of Strength
scenarios.subtitle: Floor 01 gym threshold: the Virtuoso on the near side, the Basher behind an 80 px breakable bench
scenarios.purpose: A 1024 px hall on one continuous floor lane: the spawn, a 48 px retreat shelf (288..352), the Virtuoso at 496, the 80 px bench_stack partition (640..672, y 500; Carl's class limit, TROG-Q14 resolved by TROGB-AD1) and the Basher at 776 behind it, an exit apron at 944. The shelf, the bench stack and the enemies live in the encounter sidecar.
scenarios.expected: Spawns, the checkpoint, the exit, the shelf, the bench stack and the roster come from f01_trog_strength.encounter.json; this file holds geometry only. The exit opens when both troglodytes are defeated; the bench is climbed, broken by three hero melee hits, or smashed by the Basher (rule b).
scenarios.coop: Solo with the companion, or two players: every critical route is open to both heroes (an 80 px bench both heroes can cross or break).
